query: quantile_over_time(0.95, (sum by (node) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="",id!="/"}[5m]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info)) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"}))[7d:15m]) and on (node) max by (node) (kube_node_info)
why: Node 7-day CPU usage p95 / allocatable. Used instead of the 5-minute instant value to judge the request gap (current nodes only)
